mission.title: Our Mission
mission.subtitle: Why RescueHub exists
mission.body: RescueHub exists to close the gap between at-risk shelter animals and the people who can save them. We build legally compliant software that lets 501(c)(3) rescues, municipal shelters, corporate sponsors, and the public work together without compliance risk, fund-mixing violations, or stray-hold failures. Every feature — from electronic ESIGN/UETA waivers to IRC § 513(i) sponsor acknowledgments — exists to ensure more animals leave shelters alive, on time, and with a clean paper trail.

legal.title: Legal & Compliance
legal.subtitle: What we guarantee
legal.body: We are committed to ESIGN/UETA-compliant electronic signatures, Hayden Act stray-hold tracking, IRC § 513(i) qualified sponsorship safe-harbor compliance, GDPR/CCPA data handling, and SOC 2-aligned operational controls. Sponsor pages never include calls to action; adoption feeds structurally exclude animals flagged for behavioral evaluation; donations carry legal-restriction flags to prevent fund mixing. Compliance is built into the product, not bolted on.

process.title: Our Process
process.subtitle: How rescue happens in five steps
process.body: Step 1: An animal enters the system via the public surrender portal or staff intake. Step 2: Statutory stray-hold countdown begins automatically per the Hayden Act. Step 3: Medical triage determines urgency and adoption eligibility. Step 4: At-risk animals surface to corporate sponsor broadcasts and emergency crowdfunding. Step 5: Adopters complete an ESIGN/UETA waiver; the animal leaves shelter with a complete, audit-ready chain of custody.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: Built by rescuers, for rescuers
story.body: RescueHub began as a side project for a small municipal shelter that kept losing animals to stray-hold timing errors. After seeing the same compliance gaps in two more shelters, the team rebuilt the workflow from scratch with legal review built into every release. Today we support rescues across multiple states with a single promise: every minute a shelter spends on paperwork is a minute not spent saving animals.

about-us.title: About RescueHub
about-us.subtitle: Who we are
about-us.body: We are a small team of former shelter operators, compliance attorneys, and engineers building purpose-fit software for animal welfare. RescueHub is independently operated, multi-tenant, and serves 501(c)(3) nonprofits, municipal agencies, and corporate sponsors under a single compliance framework. Our north star: fewer euthanized animals in compliance with state law.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Stay in touch
contact.body: Email: hello@rescuehub.org  ·  Press: press@rescuehub.org  ·  Compliance: compliance@rescuehub.org  ·  Emergencies (24/7 shelter line): +1 (555) 010-2024. We respond to shelter emergencies within 30 minutes, general inquiries within one business day, and security disclosures within 24 hours.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your data
privacy.body: We collect only the information needed to run the rescue platform: your contact details, the description of the animal, and optional location data for lost-pet alerts. We never sell personal data. Electronic waivers are ESIGN/UETA-compliant, and our practices follow the data-minimization principles of GDPR and CCPA. Contact privacy@rescuehub.org with any questions.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The rules of using RescueHub
terms.body: By using RescueHub you agree to these terms. The service is provided for lawful animal-welfare purposes only. Tokens are non-refundable and non-transferable, and sponsor credits are governed by our sponsor program. We may update these terms; continued use constitutes acceptance.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers
faq.body:
Q: How do I report a lost pet?
A: Start the Lost Pet Chat on the dashboard and answer the guided questions.

Q: How long is the stray hold?
A: It follows your local shelter regulations — typically 72 hours to 10 days depending on state and local law.

Q: What species are supported?
A: Dogs, cats, rabbits, turtles, birds, small mammals, reptiles, fish, and more.

Q: How do tokens work?
A: You earn tokens by sharing or by sponsor views, and spend them on services like the lost-pet search.

team.title: Our Team
team.subtitle: The people behind RescueHub
team.body: RescueHub is built by a small team of former shelter operators, compliance attorneys, engineers, and animal-welfare advocates. We believe technology should make rescue faster, fairer, and more transparent for every animal and every shelter.

partners.title: Partners & Sponsors
partners.subtitle: Who makes the work possible
partners.body: RescueHub works with municipal shelters, veterinary clinics, pet brands, and community organizations. Our corporate sponsors underwrite the token economy that makes free lost-pet searches possible, in compliance with IRC § 513(i) neutral-acknowledgment rules.

careers.title: Volunteer & Careers
careers.subtitle: Join the mission
careers.body: We are always looking for volunteers and partners: foster homes, transport drivers, shelter assistants, translators, and technical contributors. If you care about animal welfare and want to help, reach out at hello@rescuehub.org.
